title: Will not order from this company again came with cracked lids.
text: Will not order from this company again came with cracked lids.. The containers themselves feel sturdy but when I went to use them about 10 lids are cracked and broke. On the containers I did use so far very hard to snap the lid on these, figured out a trick though if you snap the corners first they may seal easier. But very bad experience with this order.
